entries.description: Avuz child skin extending Elastic. Overrides primary color (#2bb5e3 cyan), accent (#d2e314 lime), background (#f2f6fb). Login page with rounded form and lime submit button.
entries.notes: CSS targets Elastic DOM classes. If Roundcube changes Elastic class names in a future version, selectors may silently break. Review skins/elastic/ diff on upgrade.

entries.description: SSO plugin that reads ?nc_token= from the Nextcloud roundcube app, validates HMAC-SHA256 signature, decrypts the password with AES-256-CBC, and auto-authenticates the user. Falls back to login form if token is absent or invalid. Also injects avuz-overrides.css/js on every in-app page (brand colors + compose UX; forces the compose CC field always-visible).
entries.notes: Requires ROUNDCUBE_SSO_SECRET and ROUNDCUBE_CREDENTIAL_KEY env vars on both Roundcube and Nextcloud containers. Token TTL is 60 seconds. avuz-overrides.css #compose_cc rule depends on Elastic's `.hidden{display:none!important}` — verify on upgrade.

entries.description: Roundcube config: Zoho IMAP (imap.zoho.com:993 SSL) and SMTP (smtp.zoho.com:587 TLS), Redis/DB cache with messages_cache enabled, session_storage=redis when REDIS_HOST is set (SQLite sessions hit 'database is locked', causing dropped session writes and premature logouts — NOT the blank-signature bug, which was washtml; see washtml-base64-padding-fix), pt_BR locale, 'Conecta Mail' product name, identity_image_size=128 (doubled from upstream 64) for larger HTML-signature images.
entries.notes: All secrets come from env vars. ROUNDCUBE_DES_KEY must never change after first deploy or stored passwords become unreadable.

entries.description: Two-stage Docker build (base + app). PHP 8.2 FPM + Nginx + Supervisor. Entrypoint initializes DB schema on first boot. Multi-platform build scripts (arm64 local, amd64 staging/prod).
entries.notes: Registry: 10.50.100.103:8080/admin/avuz-roundcube. Base image only needs rebuild when PHP version or extensions change. scripts/build-push.sh also builds/pushes the avuz-password-broker image using the same registry/org/env/platform/push logic — see deploy/stack.reference.yml for the runtime topology. portainer-stack.yml has been removed; deploy/stack.reference.yml is now the single source of truth (push via 10.50.100.103:8080, pull via registry.avuz.app — same registry).

entries.description: Custom password driver for the core 'password' plugin. Forwards change-password requests to the internal avuz-password-broker service over HTTP (POST /reset, X-Broker-Secret header) instead of talking to Zoho directly. Roundcube never holds Zoho org/API secrets.
entries.notes: Depends on the broker service being reachable at $config['avuz_broker_url'] and sharing $config['avuz_broker_secret']. If the broker is down, password changes fail with PASSWORD_CONNECT_ERROR but login/mail flow is unaffected.

entries.description: Standalone Node/TypeScript service (Express-style HTTP server) that verifies a user's current password over IMAP against Zoho, then resets it via the Zoho Mail Admin API using per-tenant OAuth credentials. Built/pushed as its own Docker image (avuz-password-broker) by scripts/build-push.sh.
entries.notes: Holds Zoho org client_id/client_secret/refresh_token per tenant in ZOHO_TENANTS (JSON). Shares BROKER_SHARED_SECRET with Roundcube's avuz_broker_secret. No published ports — reachable only on the internal compose/Portainer network as 'broker'.

entries.description: Password-change config block in config/config.inc.php: enables the core 'password' plugin with password_driver='zoho_broker', zxcvbn strength checking (min score 2, min length 8), and the avuz_broker_url/avuz_broker_secret pair read from env.
entries.notes: Part of the same config/config.inc.php covered by the 'roundcube-config' entry; called out separately because it wires the new broker dependency. AVUZ_BROKER_URL defaults to http://broker:9000 if unset.

entries.description: In-repo reference copy of the hand-edited Portainer stack: roundcube + redis + broker services, their env vars, volumes, and depends_on wiring. Not deployed directly — Portainer is edited by hand and should be kept in sync with this file.
entries.notes: Source of truth for intended topology since there is no git-backed docker-compose deploy. Update this file whenever the live Portainer stack changes, and vice versa.

entries.description: One-char fix at rcube_washtml.php:431 — add '=' to the data-URI base64 validation class ([^0-9a-z\s/+] -> [^0-9a-z\s/+=]). Upstream 1.6.14 (commit fde14d01a) omitted the base64 padding char, so it stripped the src of any embedded image whose byte length isn't a multiple of 3, saving HTML signatures 100% blank. Verified: padded base64 survives, malicious non-base64 payloads still blocked.
entries.notes: Core file patch — re-verify on upstream upgrade; upstream may fix this line differently. Security-sensitive (the line is part of a remote-image-blocking hardening); '=' is a legit base64 char so allowing it does not weaken the check. IMPORTANT: the Dockerfile downloads the stock release tarball and overlays only listed files — a core patch has NO effect unless a matching `COPY program/lib/...` line exists in Dockerfile (added under 'Core patches'). Any future core-file patch needs its own COPY line.

entries.description: Custom in-session mail-filters plugin replacing managesieve (Zoho has no ManageSieve server or filter API). Rules stored in Postgres (avuz_filters, avuz_filter_state); applied to INBOX over the user's OWN live IMAP session on login + new-mail refresh + a manual 'apply to existing' action. Actions: move/mark-read/flag/delete(to Trash); conditions from/to/cc/subject x contains/is; first-match; bounded 1000 msgs/pass. No daemon, no stored credentials. Requires Postgres.
entries.notes: V1 is Roundcube-only (in-session) — does NOT filter for Outlook/phone-primary users. Cold-start seeds the last-uid watermark (never mass-processes existing inbox). See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-19-avuz-filters-design.md + plan (incl. hardening backlog). managesieve removed from plugins list.
